description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between reliability score and cost for three different models: the 3-Model Ensemble, the 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4. The x-axis, labeled "Cost," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Reliability Score," is also a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90, with major gridlines at 30, 50, 70, and 90. The 3-Model Ensemble (blue line with circular markers) starts at a reliability score of approximately 88 at a cost of 0 and decreases to about 73 at a cost of 10. The 2-Model Ensemble (red line with circular markers) begins at a reliability score of approximately 87 at a cost of 0 and decreases to about 73 at a cost of 10. The GPT-4 (gold line with circular markers) starts at a reliability score of approximately 90 at a cost of 0, decreases to about 65 at a cost of 5, and continues to decline to approximately 45 at a cost of 10.
